title: FY27-RQS/New Contract/Advocacy Services
agency_path: City of New York > Health and Mental Hygiene
description_text: The New York State Office of Mental Health ('OMH') requires the NYC Department of Health and Mental Hygiene to contract with The New York Center for Child Development to support the continuation of services provided by its Training and Technical Assistance Center (TTAC), (NYCCD) to operate the Citywide Perinatal and Early Childhood Mental Health Training and Technical Assistance Center (TTAC). The TTAC delivers or coordinates the delivery of trainings in evidence-based/evidence-informed, trauma-informed perinatal and early childhood mental health topics and models.
